translationRepairs: When he came of age he was a wastrel who shunned honest work and lived by smuggling salt and raiding as a outlaw.
When he came of age he was a wastrel who shunned honest work and lived by smuggling salt and raiding as an outlaw.
The indefinite article before outlaw must be 'an'.
In his early years, Qi let his sons and others go out with Qian Liu, and from time to time helped him out when he was short of means.
Qi then began to let his sons and others associate with Qian Liu, and from time to time helped him out when he was short of means.
起 is Zhong Qi, the preceding person's name, while 始 means that he then began allowing the association; it does not mean 'in his early years.'

In the second year of the Qianfu era (875), Wang Ying, a deputy general in Zhexi, rose in rebellion. Dong Chang, military commissioner at Shijian, recruited local militia to suppress the rebels, had Qian Liu appointed deputy commander, attacked Wang Ying, and defeated him.

In the second year of the Qianfu era (875), Wang Ying, a deputy general in Zhexi, rose in rebellion. Dong Chang, garrison commander at Shijian, recruited local militia to suppress the rebels, had Qian Liu appointed deputy commander, attacked Wang Ying, and defeated him.
鎮將 is a garrison commander, not the higher office of military commissioner denoted by 節度使.
That year Bi Shiduo imprisoned Gao Piao, throwing Huainan into chaos. Xu Yue, military commissioner at Liuhe, captured Suzhou.
That year Bi Shiduo imprisoned Gao Piao, throwing Huainan into chaos. Xu Yue, garrison commander at Liuhe, captured Suzhou.
六合鎮將 identifies Xu Yue as Liuhe's garrison commander, not a military commissioner.

Emperor Zhaozong had Grand Councilor Wang Pu take charge of Yuezhou. Pu petitioned that the territory be transferred to Liu, and the Weisheng command was redesignated Zhendong. Qian Liu was made Military Commissioner of both Zhenhai and Zhendong, elevated to Acting Grand Guardian and Director of the Secretariat, and granted an iron tally forgiving nine capital crimes.

Emperor Zhaozong sent Grand Councilor Wang Pu to govern Yuezhou; Pu requested that it be granted to Liu, whereupon Weisheng Army was changed to Zhendong Army, Liu was appointed Military Commissioner of Zhenhai and Zhendong, given the additional posts of Acting Grand Guardian and Director of the Secretariat, and granted an iron tally forgiving nine deaths.
